notes: Long-term (12h) arm: 12h pre-culture diluted 1:100 into M9 + biocide and grown to mid-exponential (exposure adapted, phase mid_exponential stated); its controls grown the same way without biocide. Short-term (30 min) arm: 12h M9 cultures ('mid to late exponential') exposed 30 min (acute); growth_phase left out for this arm because the pre-shift phase is given only as 'mid to late exponential'. Treatment classes: H2O2, peracetic acid, hypochlorite -> oxidative;envelope_solvent_biocide; quaternary ammonium, alcohols, glutaraldehyde, chlorophene, chlorhexidine, povidone-iodine -> envelope_solvent_biocide (povidone-iodine could also be called oxidative). Culture vessel/shaking not stated. WT re-read: MG1655 used unmodified.
